readme: AOT/trim-analyzer warning baseline. Generated from a clean rebuild (-t:Rebuild) of every IsAotCompatible module. CI (aot-trim-warnings job) fails only when a warning NOT in this list appears (a regression). A warning that WAS in this list but no longer appears is reported as an improvement, not a failure — remove its entry when you confirm the fix. Add a new entry ONLY when you have verified the warning is a genuine, permanent limitation (see check_aot_trim_warnings.py and this repo's AOT tracking issue #275 for examples: arbitrary-runtime-type JSON serialization, RoutingSlip's private JsonConstructor, upstream EF Core/Cosmos SDK constraints). Never add an entry just to silence CI — that defeats the point of this gate. Regenerate by rebuilding each module with -f net10.0 -t:Rebuild -tl:false and re-running the parser in check_aot_trim_warnings.py --update-baseline.
